title: VAL-BENCH: BELIEF CONSISTENCY AS A MEASURE FOR VALUE ALIGNMENT IN LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language model belief consistency and value preference by presenting paired prompts with opposing framings of controversial socio-political, ethical, religious, and cultural issues extracted from Wikipedia, and using an LLM-as-a-judge to measure whether the model maintains a consistent stance or exhibits specific value deviations.
